Class PythonJavaTypes

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.python.processing.util.PythonJavaTypes
@Internal public final class PythonJavaTypes extends Object
Facts about Java types that the Python transformer needs when it rewrites a class whose base is a Java type. Answered here so the transformer asks once per type instead of probing the element from Python.
Since:
5.2.0

  • Method Details

    • isThrowable

      public static boolean isThrowable(@Nullable @Nullable ClassElement classElement)
      Whether the type is a Throwable. GraalPy cannot subclass a concrete Java throwable at run time, so the transformer replaces such a base with a Python exception in runtime code.
      Parameters:
      classElement - The type
      Returns:
      Whether it is a throwable

    • isPythonClass

      public static boolean isPythonClass(@Nullable @Nullable ClassElement classElement)
      Whether the type is a Python class: one of the sources being compiled, or the generated bridge of a Python class compiled earlier (by another source root of the project, or into a library) found on the class path. Such a bridge is a Java class, but its Python class is what an import of it refers to at run time, so the transformer keeps the import instead of replacing it with a reference to the Java type.
      Parameters:
      classElement - The type
      Returns:
      Whether it is a Python class

    • isExtensibleClass

      public static boolean isExtensibleClass(@Nullable @Nullable ClassElement classElement)
      Whether a Python class extending the type gets a generated Java class extending it and a Python base standing in for it at run time: a class (abstract or concrete) that is not a Throwable. Interfaces are stripped from the runtime bases and throwables become Python exceptions.
      Parameters:
      classElement - The type
      Returns:
      Whether it is a Java class a Python class extends through the generated class

    • isSameOrBoxedType

      public static boolean isSameOrBoxedType(ClassElement left, ClassElement right)
      Whether two types are the same type once primitives are boxed. A Python int hint resolves to the primitive int while a Java ID argument resolves to the boxed Integer; Python has no overloading, so a method declared with the one overrides a method declared with the other.
      Parameters:
      left - A type
      right - Another type
      Returns:
      true if the types are the same, or a primitive and its wrapper, with the same array dimensions

    • isPrimitiveOrBoxedType

      public static boolean isPrimitiveOrBoxedType(ClassElement type)
      Whether the type is a primitive or one of the primitive wrappers.
      Parameters:
      type - The type
      Returns:
      true for a primitive or a wrapper such as Integer
